question_sentence: The far-right AfD party is on course to win its first state level elections in which German state?
Which professional golfer won the FedEx Cup and passed Tiger Woods to top the PGA Tour’s official all-time money list?
Former UK prime minister Keir Starmer announced he was stepping down as MP for which London seat?
Nasa launched a new space telescope named after which female astronomer?
Numbers of which endangered New Zealand bird have reached a 75-year high following a record breeding season?
Giorgia Meloni became Italy’s longest-serving prime minister since the Second World War by reaching how many days in office?
Which pop star shed her last name and announced the name of her soon-to-be-released 10th album?
G20 finance ministers met this week in which US city?
New research suggests which artificial sweetener is associated with “major cardiovascular events” including strokes and heart attacks?
The creator of which popular YouTube series has announced it is to end?
Which US president is featured on new $1 coins released by the US Mint this week?
evidence: Commemorative $1 coins featuring President Donald Trump’s portrait appeared to be out of stock within hours after going on sale through the US Mint on Wednesday. The release marks the first time a living president has appeared on a US coin since 1926.

question_sentence: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem passed away this week at age 92. What was the name of the magazine she founded in 1972?
evidence: Gloria Steinem partnered with child care advocate Dorothy Pitman Hughes in 1972 to co-found Ms. Magazine, thought to be the first national American feminist magazine, which is still published today.

question_sentence: What was the name of the tropical storm that dumped more than 20 inches of rain on parts of Texas this week?
evidence: Heavy rain from Tropical Storm Edouard inundated parts of east Texas this week. The storm has since weakened, but rivers could remain dangerously high for days.

question_sentence: Which planet is the closest to the sun?
evidence: Mercury is the closest to the sun. This week, an ambitious mission to study the little-explored planet reached a major milestone after an eight-year journey and billions of miles traveled.

question_sentence: Which of the following does ICE plan to equip all of its agents with by the end of the month?
evidence: All ICE agents in the field are expected to have body cameras by the end of September, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said this week.

question_sentence: Which is the largest water reservoir in the US?
evidence: A megadrought has drained Lake Mead, the nation’s largest water reservoir, by 70%. Officials are now facing tough choices over who will get less water.

question_sentence: Tim Cook recently stepped down as CEO of which company?
evidence: Tim Cook’s 15-year run as Apple CEO came to an end this week. John Ternus, Apple’s senior vice president of hardware engineering, took over the top job.

question_sentence: Which US national park was hit by deadly flash flooding this week?
evidence: At least two people were killed after flash flooding washed out footbridges and campgrounds at Arizona’s Grand Canyon.

question_sentence: Which type of lettuce was tied to an illness outbreak this summer?
evidence: After this summer’s illness outbreak tied to iceberg lettuce, a growing number of health experts now say it’s generally safe to eat.

question_sentence: Which type of pet did Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce recently add to their family?
evidence: Taylor Swift is a certified cat person (she has three: Meredith Grey, Olivia Benson and Benjamin Button). But there’s room for a dog, too. She and Travis Kelce announced this week that they’ve welcomed a fluffy white Samoyed named Wendy into the family.
